name: Vals AI
note: Independent evaluation company; runs every model in its own harness.

name: US Center for AI Standards and Innovation (NIST)
note: Government evaluator; tests US models with cyber safeguards disabled where applicable.

name: ExploitGym authors (UC Berkeley RDI with Anthropic, OpenAI and Google researchers)
note: Co-written with researchers from Anthropic, OpenAI and Google; Claude results "obtained in collaboration with Anthropic". Results on those developers' models are not independent and are refused.

name: Microsoft researchers (benchmark authors)
note: Develops models itself: its results on Microsoft models are self-evaluations and are refused. Microsoft is also an investor in OpenAI and Anthropic; neither CTI-REALM nor ExCyTIn states that either commissioned it.

name: Graphistry (bots-bench)
note: Makes Louie.ai, an AI investigation product, and builds no models. Runs in its own Louie harness and operator-reported runs are not recorded: only runs in third-party agents (opencode, Claude Code, Codex CLI) on its private 59-question test.
